title: Committee of Supply – Head R (Ministry of Law)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head R (Ministry of Law)

sections.label: Singapore international legal services hub
sections.summary: MinLaw develops Singapore as an international legal services hub, and SIAC was the third most preferred arbitral institution in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head R of the Estimates be reduced by $100." The Ministry of Law (MinLaw) plays an important role in developing Singapore as a hub for international legal services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: In 2018, the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) emerged as the third most preferred arbitral institution in the world and the most preferred arbitral institution based in Asia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: For instance, in 2018, the United States (US) topped the foreign user rankings for the first time.

sections.label: Maxwell Chambers case management offices
sections.summary: Maxwell Chambers Suites has the world's highest concentration of case management offices and hosts INSOL International's first physical expansion since 1982.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Moving back to the cut, Maxwell	Chambers Suites	currently	has	the	highest concentration of case management offices in the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The INSOL International Asia Hub in Maxwell Chambers Suite is INSOL International's first-ever physical expansion since the establishment of its London headquarters in 1982.

sections.label: Singapore IP protection ranking
sections.summary: Singapore is ranked second in the world and highest in Asia for IP protection in the World Economic Forum's 2019 report.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: Singapore is ranked second in the world and the highest in Asia for having the best IP protection as stated in the World Economic Forum's Global Competitiveness Report 2019.

sections.label: IPOS International IP experts
sections.summary: IPOS International, a wholly-owned IPOS subsidiary, has over 100 IP experts in strategy, management, patent search and analysis, and education.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: IPOS International, a wholly-owned subsidiary of IPOS, has over 100 IP experts in areas of IP strategy and management, patent search and analysis, and IP education and training.

sections.label: Illuminate for Enterprises diagnostic tool
sections.summary: Illuminate for Enterprises, an online diagnostic tool by IPOS International, gives users an overview of their company's IP, intangible asset health, and management gaps and risks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: IPOS International’s suite of tools related to IP assets, for example, Illuminate for Enterprises, which is an online diagnostic tool developed by IPOS International, assists users to obtain a quick overview of their company’s IP, the health of their intangible assets, as well as any management gaps and risks.

sections.label: Offence requires payment and no work
sections.summary: Under the current legal framework, an offence is committed only if money has been paid and no work has been done at all.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: Under the current legal framework, if my understanding is correct, an offence is committed only if money has been paid by the consumer and no work has been done at all.

sections.label: Maintenance defaulters deterrence measures
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry could impose deterrent measures, such as fines, on those who breach court maintenance orders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: While the provisions of the Women’s Charter provides for sanctions or, in extreme cases, even imprisonment terms, to those who default in maintenance, by the time the law takes its course, it could provide cold comfort to the wives and children, many of whom live with relative financial strain.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: So, could the Ministry consider imposing measures of sufficient deterrence, so that defaulters who breach Court orders in maintaining their families will think twice, such as imposing fines of appropriate severity, in addition to any existing penalties?

sections.label: Publishing ECT judgments
sections.summary: The passage suggests selectively publishing more landmark and instructive Employment Claims Tribunal judgments as useful references and precedents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: With ECT having jurisdiction to adjudicate both salary-related disputes as well as wrongful dismissal claims, it now hears more cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Past decisions of ECT would be extremely useful as a source of reference and precedents and should thus be made available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: For a start, I would like to suggest that the more landmark and instructive judgments be selectively published.

sections.label: MOM cash advances for unpaid wages
sections.summary: The passage suggests MOM issue cash advancements to pay part of an insolvent company worker's unpaid wages and stand in as preferred creditor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Workers’ lack of knowledge of the workings of our Court system exacerbates this problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: There is thus a need to simplify and expedite the enforcement mechanism to facilitate workers’ recovery of moneys.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: One suggestion, in the context of an insolvent company, is for MOM to look at issuing cash advancements, which could be used to pay part of the worker’s unpaid wages, and thereafter to stand in place of the worker as a preferred creditor to recover the advanced moneys upon distribution of the insolvent company’s assets.

sections.label: Legal aid eligibility and costs
sections.summary: The passage states legal aid is only available to those meeting criteria, and some with meritorious claims do not pursue them due to prohibitive costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: Legal aid schemes provide assistance to those who are unable to afford legal advice or representation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: Legal aid, however, is only available to those who meet the criteria and some people may not be eligible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: The claims may have merit but the legal costs may be prohibitive and so they decide not to pursue their cases.

sections.label: Cross-border enforcement of mediated settlements
sections.summary: The passage states this will pave the way for cross-border enforcement of mediated settlement agreements and notes SMC's mediations and settlement rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: This will pave the way for cross-border enforcement of mediated settlement agreements, give businesses greater certainty and assurance and encourage the greater use of mediation to resolve international commercial disputes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: I note that in the past three years, SMC has conducted under its auspices close to 1,500 mediations with a recorded settlement rate of between 65% and 69% each year.

sections.label: SIAC caseload and arbitrators
sections.summary: The passage states that 80% of SIAC's caseload is international and it has over 400 expert arbitrators from over 40 jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Based on information from its website, 80% of SIAC’s caseload is international in nature and they have an experienced international panel of over 400 expert arbitrators from over 40 jurisdictions around the world.

sections.label: Tech-Celerate for Law scheme
sections.summary: In May 2019, MinLaw and partners launched Tech-Celerate for Law, funding up to 70% of first-year technology adoption costs for Singapore law practices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In May 2019, MinLaw, together with the Law Society, Enterprise Singapore and Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) launched Tech-Celerate for Law.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is a scheme for Singapore law practices to get funding support of up to 70% for the first-year cost of adopting baseline and advanced technology solutions.

sections.label: Support for small law firms
sections.summary: A member asks how MinLaw prepares small law firms lacking resources to be future-ready and whether more engagement sessions would be considered.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This may lead to some of these lawyers feeling left out of the efforts that MinLaw has been making in supporting the profession build capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I am, therefore, wondering how MinLaw is preparing small law firms, which may not have sufficient resources, including time and money, to be future-ready.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If awareness and interest in such technology adoption is not high, would MinLaw consider having more engagement and sharing sessions with smaller law firms to encourage the move towards adopting new technology?

sections.label: Former Henderson Secondary School reuse
sections.summary: The former Henderson Secondary School state property was transformed into a space with a childcare centre, nursing home, dialysis centre and urban farm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: One excellent example is what was done to the former Henderson Secondary School.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: This state property has been transformed into an integrated space comprising a childcare centre, a nursing home and dialysis centre as well as an urban farm.

sections.label: Simplified track divorce cases
sections.summary: In 2019 over 55% of divorce cases were decided on the simplified track, up from 24% in 2015, and the Government accepted the RERF recommendations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For example, in 2019, more than 55% of divorce cases were decided on the simplified track, which is faster, less costly and, obviously, less painful through the process, up from just 24% in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The Government has, therefore, accepted the recommendations of the committee to Review and Enhance Reforms in the Family Justice System (RERF).

sections.label: Maintenance regime and enforcement reforms
sections.summary: The Government is considering a simpler maintenance regime and will introduce legislation implementing recommendations from two committees on court efficiency and enforcement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The Government is also considering how to make the overall maintenance regime, both in terms of the orders made as well as the enforcement, simpler and more effective.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Members will know that two committees – one convened by my Ministry, the other by the Judiciary – made broad-ranging recommendations to enhance the efficiency, affordability and overall effectiveness of our Court system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have completed public consultation and further discussions with key stakeholders and will introduce legislation to implement some of these changes in due course.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Mr Patrick Tay raised concerns with the enforcement of Employment Claims Tribunal (ECT) orders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We are studying recommendations to streamline and simplify the enforcement of judgments and orders and will announce more details in due course once we have completed that.

sections.label: Funds for unpaid salary workers
sections.summary: Workers with no other alternative to recover unpaid salaries can tap on the Short-Term Relief Fund and the Migrant Workers' Assistance Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Overall, this leads to a potentially bigger problem in the system for a longer time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: That said, for workers with no other alternative to recover unpaid salaries, the Short-Term Relief Fund (STRF) and the Migrant Workers' Assistance Fund (MWAF) can be tapped on.

sections.label: IPOS SGX Intangible Disclosure Scheme
sections.summary: IPOS and SGX launched the Intangible Disclosure Evaluation and Audit Scheme, which subsidises up to $10,000 for companies to undergo an intangible asset evaluation and audit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: First, IPOS and the Singapore Exchange (SGX) have launched a new Intangible Disclosure Evaluation and Audit Scheme – a bit of a mouthful, so we have short-formed it to IDEAS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: IDEAS provides a subsidy of up to $10,000 for companies to undergo an intangible asset evaluation and audit.

sections.label: AI Patent Acceleration Initiative
sections.summary: Patent acceleration initiatives were expanded last year to cover AI patent applications, which can now be granted as early as six months after filing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Third, we have expanded our patent acceleration initiatives last year to cover AI patent applications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: AI patent applications can now be granted as early as six months after filing.

sections.label: Legal Aid Criteria and iLAB Chatbot
sections.summary: The key criteria for assessing legal aid applications will reduce processing time by at least two weeks, and LAB launched the first phase of its chatbot iLAB.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: These are the key criteria in assessing an application for legal aid.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This will reduce processing time by at least two weeks, speeding up the process so that access to legal aid can be granted more quickly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Second, LAB has just launched the first phase of its new chatbot, "iLAB".

sections.label: Criminal Legal Aid Means Criteria
sections.summary: MinLaw worked with partners on the Criminal Legal Assistance Steering Committee to review the means criteria for the Criminal Legal Aid Scheme, adopting the new civil legal aid criteria and limits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MinLaw has also been working with our partners on the Criminal Legal Assistance Steering Committee (CLA SC), including the Law Society as well as the Criminal Bar, to review the means criteria for the Criminal Legal Aid Scheme (CLAS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will adopt the new means criteria and limits for civil legal aid, what I have just outlined, for CLAS as well.

sections.label: CLAS Fellowship Law Firm Sponsors
sections.summary: Since 2015, five largest law firms have sponsored the CLAS Fellowship to enable lawyers to join LSPBS exclusively to handle criminal legal aid cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Since 2015, the five largest law firms, Allen & Gledhill, Dentons Rodyk, Drew & Napier, Rajah & Tann and WongPartnership, have generously sponsored the CLAS Fellowship to enable lawyers to join LSPBS exclusively to handle criminal legal aid cases.

sections.label: Protection from Harassment Court
sections.summary: The Ministry has put in place various legal frameworks, and over the last year or so established a new Protection from Harassment Court.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: My Ministry has put in place various legal frameworks to deal with these issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have, over the last year or so, established a new Protection from Harassment Court.

sections.label: Community Mediation Centre success rate
sections.summary: Over the past three years, more than 80% of cases mediated at the Community Mediation Centre were successfully resolved through mediation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In the past three years, more than 80% of the cases mediated before the Community Mediation Centre (CMC) has resulted in a successful resolution arising from the mediation.

sections.label: Claimant fees for small claims
sections.summary: Claimants pay only $10 for claims valued up to $5,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For example, claimants are only required to pay $10 for claims up to $5,000 in value.

sections.label: CFA framework and free judgments
sections.summary: After public consultations, a CFA framework is being introduced for certain proceedings, with study of wider use and more free online judgments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Following public consultations last year, we are working on introducing a CFA framework for certain categories of proceedings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The framework will help our lawyers and law practices by levelling the playing field for Singaporean lawyers and law practices, as against foreign lawyers who may already be able to offer such agreements in their own jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We are also studying whether allowing CFAs for a wider range of proceedings can further promote access to justice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Our initiatives include increasing free access to Singapore judgments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Steps have been taken to make more Supreme Court judgments from 2000 freely available online, and also potentially even earlier judgments, earlier than 2000.

sections.label: Hague Apostille Convention accession
sections.summary: The government agrees the Hague Apostille Convention will be useful and is working towards accession.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On the Hague Apostille Convention, we agree that this will be useful and we are currently working towards its accession.

sections.label: Automation savings for law firm
sections.summary: A firm saved time and cost by automating routine tasks, cutting document reference checking time by up to 66%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The firm achieved time and cost savings from automating routine but important tasks, including shortening the time required to complete the checking of references in documents by up to 66%.

sections.label: China-Ready Programme for lawyers
sections.summary: The first run of the China-Ready Programme for Singapore lawyers will be conducted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Third, we will be conducting the first run of the China-Ready Programme for Singapore lawyers this year.

sections.label: Power District design submissions
sections.summary: 79 submissions were received and will be distilled into design principles guiding the Power District's development for 15 to 20 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: A total of 79 submissions were received, which demonstrates the interest of the public and the professional sector in trying to contribute to ideas as to what can be done.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: These ideas will be distilled into design principles guiding the Power District's development for the next 15 to 20 years, including the former Pasir Panjang Power Station A.

sections.label: Tanglin Road community space, OneMap 3D
sections.summary: SLA is partnering NParks to develop a Tanglin Road site into a community use space, and OneMap 3D will fully launch later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: SLA is also partnering the National Parks Board to develop a site at Tanglin Road into a community use space with a playground, benches, something that will appeal to members of the public.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: There will be a full launch of the OneMap 3D that will take place later this year.

sections.label: 3D Singapore Sandbox launch
sections.summary: SLA will launch the 3D Singapore Sandbox this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: SLA will be launching the 3D Singapore Sandbox this year.

sections.label: Model clause and party choice
sections.summary: A model clause is useful but parties must want to come to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I can speak a little more slowly now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, a model clause is useful but parties must want to come to Singapore.

sections.label: Accessible law and neutral hearings
sections.summary: Singapore law must be accessible, first-rate and commercial, and parties must get neutral, rule-of-law hearings in Maxwell Chambers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: First, we have to make sure that Singapore law is accessible, that it is first-rate, it is commercial.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Second, we must build a system that is neutral, that is based on the rule of law, that parties, when they come into Singapore, when they make their investments into Singapore or they choose Singapore as a forum, they know that they will get first-class hearings, hearings that will not be unduly interfered with, hearings that will be governed by the rule of law and, as far as possible, in our best-in-class facilities as well, in Maxwell Chambers.

sections.label: Strong neutral legal system for IP
sections.summary: No one will choose Singapore for patents or IP rights without a strong neutral legal system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I am not sure that is capable of a short answer but I will try.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: We have to, first, realise that no one will choose Singapore to file their patents in or to enhance or enforce their IP rights if we do not have a strong neutral legal system.

sections.label: IDEAS system start to end
sections.summary: The speaker says they want to be with the system from start to end, citing IDEAS as an example mentioned earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Third, we also want to make sure that we be with the system from start to end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, I mentioned in my speech earlier, IDEAS, for instance.
